SHIVANI · A02 · 06:45–07:10 AM

A New Year Surprise Interrupted

Shivani × Rohan · Approved original Hinglish dialogue

APPROVED
<div class="a02-prose">
Narration — 06:45 AM
Main door khula. Rohan morning walk se wapas aaya, shoes utare aur kitchen se paani ka glass uthaya.
Bedroom ke andar Shivani dressing mirror ke saamne khadi thi. Burgundy saree pehen chuki thi, lekin pallu set karna aur baal banana abhi baaki tha.
Rohan: Madam lecturer! Happy New Year! Ghar mein koi hai ya sab vacation pe chale gaye?
Shivani: Kitchen mein paani hai. Aur haan, Happy New Year, Mr. Late Entry.
Rohan: Late? Main toh bilkul time pe aaya hoon.
Shivani: Tumhari ghadi ke hisaab se duniya chalti toh students ko kabhi attendance ki problem nahi hoti.
Rohan hanste hue bedroom ki taraf badha.
Rohan: Achha, aaj itni subah bedroom band kyun hai?
Shivani: Kyunki andar ek important preparation chal rahi hai.
Rohan: College ki?
Shivani: Nahi. Aaj ki preparation sirf tumhare liye hai.
Rohan darwaze ke paas ruk gaya.
Rohan: Oh! Toh mujhe invitation milega ya appointment book karni padegi?
Shivani: Appointment nahi. Bas thoda patience.
Rohan: Patience toh hai, lekin tum jab aise suspense banati ho na, expectations badh jaati hain.
Shivani: Phir expectations sambhal kar rakhna. Surprise kharab mat karna.
Darwaze ki halki opening se Rohan ko burgundy fabric ki ek jhalak mili.
Rohan: Ek minute... nayi saree?
Shivani: Tumne dekha kya?
Rohan: Bas colour. Waise burgundy tum par hamesha achha lagta hai.
Shivani mirror mein apni reflection dekhkar muskurayi.
Shivani: Sirf colour ki tareef? Poora surprise dekhoge toh kya kahoge?
Rohan: Woh toh dekhne ke baad hi decide karunga.
Shivani: Toh bahar jao. Aur aankhein band rakhna.
Rohan: Main apne hi ghar mein guest ban gaya?
Shivani: Special guest. Ab jao.
Rohan hansa aur living room mein chala gaya.
Narration — 07:03 AM
Shivani ne blouse ki sleeve theek ki, pallu shoulder par set kiya aur earrings uthaye.
Living room mein achanak Rohan ka phone baja.
Uski awaaz badal gayi.
Rohan: Hello... haan, boliye.
Kuch pal woh chupchaap sunta raha.
Rohan: Okay. Samajh gaya. Main nikal raha hoon.
Shivani ne dressing rok di.
Shivani: Rohan? Kya hua?
Rohan bedroom ke bahar aaya.
Rohan: Sorry, Shivani. Urgent work call hai. Mujhe abhi jaana padega.
Shivani: Abhi? New Year ki subah?
Rohan: I know. Mujhe bhi achha nahi lag raha.
Shivani ne haath mein pakda earring dressing table par rakh diya.
Shivani: Main tumhare liye kuch special plan kar rahi thi.
Rohan: Mujhe pata hai. Aur main sach mein dekhna chahta tha.
Shivani: Dekhna chahte the, lekin dekha toh nahi.
Rohan kuch seconds chup raha.
Rohan: Toh promise raha. Surprise pending hai, cancelled nahi.
Shivani ki halki muskurahat laut aayi.
Shivani: Theek hai. Lekin agali baar tumhari timing meri hogi.
Rohan: Deal.
Narration — 07:10 AM
Rohan apni zaroori cheezein lekar nikal gaya.
Darwaza band hua toh Shivani kuch pal wahin khadi rahi.
Phir mirror ke paas lautkar usne burgundy pallu dobara uthaya.
Shivani (dheere se): Pending hai... cancelled nahi.
Usne apni adhoori taiyaari ko dekha. Surprise ka waqt badal gaya tha, uska mann nahi.
SCENE COMPLETE — Approved.

source_html_lines_exact:
SHIVANI · A03 · 07:12–07:45 AM

The Unsent Photograph

APPROVED
Narration — 07:12 AM
Rohan ke jaane ke baad bedroom mein ek ajeeb si khamoshi thi.
Shivani dressing table ke saamne khadi thi. Burgundy saree ka pallu abhi uske shoulder par loosely rakha tha. Ek earring pehen chuki thi, doosra dressing table par pada tha.
Usne mirror mein khud ko dekha.
Shivani (dheere se): Happy New Year, Mrs. Bad Timing.
Woh khud hi halki si hans padi.
Rohan ki baat yaad aayi.
Surprise pending hai, cancelled nahi.
Shivani ne doosra earring uthaya.
Shivani: Achha, Mr. Rohan. Dekhte hain.
Usne taiyaari poori karne ka faisla kiya.
Narration — The Burgundy Look
Burgundy saree ka fabric soft light mein wine-red aur deep maroon ke beech shade badal raha tha. Uski narrow woven border pallu ke kinare par subtle shine de rahi thi.
Matching blouse neatly tailored tha. Uski sleeves shoulders par smoothly baithi thi, neckline simple aur elegant thi, aur fitted waist se saree ka silhouette naturally defined ho raha tha.
Shivani ne pleats ko ek-ek karke straighten kiya. Pallu ko shoulder par arrange karke pin lagayi, phir mirror mein side se dekha ki drape symmetrical hai ya nahi.
Uske dark hair khule hue the. Usne unhe brush karke ek taraf settle kiya, jisse earrings clearly dikh rahi thi.
Makeup minimal tha: softly defined eyes, warm lipstick aur ek chhoti bindi.
Shivani (mirror se): Ab bolna, sirf colour achha hai.
Yeh sochkar uske chehre par muskurahat aa gayi.
Woh Rohan ko surprise dena chahti thi. Sirf nayi saree dikhane ke liye nahi, balki New Year ki subah ka ek personal moment banane ke liye.
Lekin moment adhura reh gaya tha.
Narration — 07:22 AM
Shivani ne dressing table se apna personal phone uthaya.
Camera open kiya.
Mirror ke saamne khade hokar usne pehle framing check ki. Background mein neatly made bed, curtain se aati soft winter light aur dressing table ka ek corner dikh raha tha.
Usne phone vertical rakha, thoda sa angle change kiya taaki saree ki pleats aur pallu dono frame mein aa sakein.
Ek haath mein phone tha. Doosre se usne pallu ki border halka sa straighten ki.
Uske shoulders relaxed the. Chin slightly raised, expression confident aur naturally warm.
Click.
Ek photograph.
Selected A03 mirror-selfie visualization
Shivani ne gallery mein picture open ki.
Usmein burgundy saree ki rich colour, neatly styled hair aur uski soft smile clearly captured thi. Pose elegant tha, jaise kisi special occasion ke liye privately ready hui ho.
Shivani: Not bad, Mrs. Lecturer.
Usne photograph dobara dekhi.
Phir Rohan ka naam phone mein open karne ke baare mein socha.
Shivani (soch mein): Abhi bhej doon?
Uski ungli ek pal ke liye ruki.
Rohan ne kaha tha ki surprise pending hai.
Shivani ne phone neeche kar diya.
Shivani: Nahi. Kuch surprises screen par nahi, saamne dekhne chahiye.
Usne photograph kisi ko send nahi ki.
Image sirf uske personal phone ki local gallery mein reh gayi—na message, na print, na cloud upload.
Narration — 07:38 AM
Shivani ne saree carefully utarkar fold ki aur wardrobe mein rakhi.
Usne apne college ke liye professional outfit pehna, dupatta properly arrange kiya aur bag mein academic notes check kiye.
Mirror mein ab ek different Shivani thi: composed, practical aur din ki responsibilities ke liye ready.
Lekin Rohan ka unfinished surprise uske mann mein tha.
Shivani (muskurakar): Pending, Mr. Rohan. Cancelled nahi.
Phone bag mein chala gaya.
Photograph gallery mein reh gayi.
SCENE COMPLETE — Approved.

source_html_lines_exact:
SHIVANI · B03 · 10:45–11:30

B03 — Four-Way Faculty Room Banter

APPROVED

10:45 AM — Faculty room mein Shivani ke saath Pooja, Kriti aur Dr. Aarav Sethi the. Aarav ke clever compliments se Pooja aur Kriti pehle se familiar the; aaj unki shared teasing ek step zyada mischievous ho gayi.
Part 1 — Pooja × Aarav
Aarav: Pooja, aap har baar mujhe dekhkar smile kyun karti hain? Kuch kehna hai toh privately bhi keh sakti hain.
Pooja: Private mein bulaoge toh sirf baatein karoge, Dr. Sethi?
Aarav hansa. Pooja apne jawab par blush kar gayi, lekin nazar nahi hatayi.
Part 2 — Kriti × Aarav
Kriti: Aarav, tumhe har conversation ko interesting banana zaroori lagta hai?
Aarav: Interesting company mile toh main time ka hisaab bhool jaata hoon.
Kriti: Phir stamina bhi achha hona chahiye. Har interesting conversation jaldi khatam nahi hoti.
Aarav: Kriti, mujhe lag raha hai tum mujhe deliberately challenge kar rahi ho.
Kriti: Challenge samajhna hai ya invitation, woh tumhari interpretation hai.
Pooja hans padi. Kriti ne coffee cup ke peeche apni smile chhupayi.
Part 3 — Shivani × Aarav
Aarav: Shivani, aap itni composed kaise rehti hain? Kabhi kisi ne aapko genuinely nervous kiya?
Shivani: Koshish bahuton ne ki hai.
Aarav: Toh mujhe bhi ek chance milega? Main challenges aadhe mein chhodne ka aadmi nahi hoon.
Shivani: Chance lene se pehle yaad rakhna, Aarav. Main expectations bhi high rakhti hoon aur evaluation bhi strict karti hoon.
Pooja aur Kriti ne ek doosre ko dekha. Ab chaaron ek hi playful exchange mein shamil the.
Part 4 — Common conversation; everyone joins
Kriti: Ek minute! Aarav, tum teenon ko individually impress karne ki koshish kar rahe ho?
Aarav: Main toh bas interesting company enjoy kar raha hoon.
Pooja: Achha? Teen confident women ek saath hon toh pressure handle kar loge?
Aarav: Pressure se problem nahi. Bas mujhe cheezein jaldi mein karna pasand nahi.
Kriti: Oho! Matlab patience bhi hai?
Shivani: Pooja, Kriti, tum dono iski interview panel ban gayi ho kya?
Pooja: Bilkul! Candidate ko experience, patience aur stamina—teenon prove karne padenge.
Aarav: Aur agar candidate saare rounds clear kar de?
Kriti: Toh final decision hum teenon milkar lenge.
Pooja ki hansi chhoot gayi. Kriti ne coffee cup uthaya.
Shivani: Tum logon ne toh faculty room ko interview room bana diya. Aarav, pehle written test pass kar lo. Practical ki permission baad mein milegi.
Aarav: Teen examiners? Yeh toh unfair advantage hai.
Pooja: Abhi toh humne difficult questions poochhe bhi nahi.
Aarav ek pal ke liye chup hua. Teenon women hans padi. Unke playful exchanges voluntary aur mutually understood the; koi actual private appointment ya invitation agree nahi hua.
Presentation coordination request
Kriti ke paas 1 PM ke presentation review ke liye connectivity request aa gayi.
Kriti: Achha, jokes over. Shivani, 1 PM ke presentation review mein phone connectivity check karni hogi.
Shivani: Okay. Main AV desk par phone lekar aa jaungi.
Conversation professional mode mein laut aayi.
Aarav's playful history here is lightly established staffroom familiarity, not an invented prior affair. Shivani's actual personal phone is handed over only around 13:00 in C01.
